name: soundHandle
meaning: channel of the calling sound 0x25 started in state 0 (Sound_Play 0x4364be, stored as a word 0x4364c9); stopped and zeroed by SetState and Reset

name: state
meaning: DaffyElf state: 0 calling (faces Ralph, sound 0x25), 1 question box open, 2 waiting for the cinematic to finish, 3 waiting for Ralph in CINEBOX, 4 answer being replayed (byte store 0x43677f, movzx switch 0x436335)

name: cineId
meaning: PROPERTY CINE (record +0x08); first argument of Cine_Start 0x43644d

name: cineTextIndex
meaning: PROPERTY CINETEXT (+0x18); its low byte is the class string index of cineText (0x436249)

name: cineText
meaning: Text_GetClassString(cineTextIndex) (0x43625b), passed to Cine_Start as its text

name: cineBox
meaning: PROPERTY CINEBOX (Scn_GetPropBox +0x0c): in state 3 Ralph's x/z inside it starts the cinematic; also Cine_Start's box

name: answerTextIndex
meaning: PROPERTY ANSWERTEXTINDEX (+0x04): first class string of the question box (Dialog_Begin 0x4367f5)

name: answerCount
meaning: PROPERTY ANSWERNUMBER (+0x00) truncated to a byte (0x4362c7): Dialog_Begin's answer count

name: dialog
meaning: the question box: Dialog_Begin / Dialog_Update / Dialog_UpdateAnswer; answerText[] is what the choice handlers print (g_pDaffyElf+0xb0+4i)
